title: Chuyến phà đêm
about: Round x18 (album 13), the user: "làm album và chuyển sang sáng tác album tiếp theo": electronic sleep ambient (style ngu-dt) as albums 10-11, on a less common progression of its own (template 5), slow (50 bpm), waves, pad, arp, sub, an improvised keys tune with a long echo. No drums. An original piece.
